"""Queue reader for the nightly import."""
import time

EMPTY_PAUSE_SECONDS = 45
TAKE_LIMIT = 200


def read_batch(queue):
    """Take one batch of records, waiting while the queue has nothing ready."""
    batch = queue.take(TAKE_LIMIT)
    while not batch:
        time.sleep(EMPTY_PAUSE_SECONDS)
        batch = queue.take(TAKE_LIMIT)
    return batch
